title: Getting Started with Next.js & App Router
excerpt: Learn how the modern Next.js App Router simplifies routing, layouts, and server components.
content:
Next.js brings React into the modern full-stack world. With the App Router, building complex web applications becomes intuitive thanks to nested layouts, automatic code-splitting, and built-in server-side rendering.

By leveraging React Server Components (RSC), your components execute on the server by default, drastically reducing bundle size and improving initial page load performance.

title: Mastering Dynamic Routes in Next.js
excerpt: Deep dive into dynamic segment folders, catch-all routes, and async params.
content:
Dynamic routing in Next.js relies on clean folder naming conventions using brackets like [id] or [...slug]. When a user visits a dynamic route, Next.js matches the path segment and provides the parameter directly to your Page component via an async params Promise.

This pattern eliminates the need for complex client-side routing configs and makes building dashboards, e-commerce product catalogs, and blogs effortless.

title: Styling Modern Web Apps with Tailwind CSS v4
excerpt: How to craft clean, responsive, dark-mode first user interfaces with Tailwind CSS.
content:
Tailwind CSS v4 introduces a streamlined engine with zero-config setup and lightning-fast compilation. Utilizing utility classes for layout (flex, grid), spacing, and responsive design keeps UI code concise and maintainable.

Pairing Tailwind's zinc color palette with subtle borders and glassmorphism produces a sleek, modern developer-focused aesthetic.
